title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Solo #27 (가로 띠·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Japanese woman, an adult, in her early 20s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size — but projecting forward prominently from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, every other curve of her oversized at once around it: enormous round hips flaring out more than three times the waistline's width, gigantic soft thighs. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin, pastel pink and lilac eyeshadow, large round eyes enlarged by circle lenses with bright real catchlights, soft round blush, dewy pink lips, a sweet, shy smile, natural soft black hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, real pores, real living eyes, 8 bars piercings set with rubies in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of platinum a necklace. Full body painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 37% of the way down her figure from the top and about 79% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines), wide mother-of-pearl bands following the contours of the body, with dense scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, with peacock-eye dot motifs filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, with floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
